definition: Your row of played cards, in the order played.
window: Grows by one card per play or interrupt.
does: Decides chaining (only the last card counts) and is the visible record of play.
does_not: Never loses a card. Nothing is taken back.

contrast.hand: The hand is private and changes; the Line is public and only grows.
contrast.discard: Discarded cards leave the game; Line cards stay.
contrast.provenance: The Line is the board state; provenance is the hash-linked log of how it got there.
